name: Phase 11A supplementary table questions
author: assistant; written from corpus c6 tables (AIAYN Table 3, MOSHI Table 4) and checked against the LaTeX source. PROVISIONAL: no independent review.
why: the existing sets have no symbolic-header, similarly-named-metric, caption-only or prose+table questions
gold_format: as eval/phase7/table_question_set.json: gold.rows[].id = strings that locate the row line, cells = strings it must contain; caption_only = any chunk of the table answers; quotes = prose evidence (gold_chunks rule)

questions.question: In the Transformer paper's table of model variations, what development BLEU and perplexity does the variant with 4 attention heads get?
In the Transformer paper's model variations, what development BLEU does the (B) variant that only reduces the attention key dimension to 16 obtain?
Which development BLEU does the Transformer variant whose inner-layer dimensionality is 4096 reach in the model variation experiments?
In the Transformer model variations, what development BLEU and perplexity result from a dropout rate of 0.0?
What development BLEU does the Transformer get with label smoothing of 0.2 in the variation experiments?
In the Transformer variation experiments, what perplexity and BLEU does a model with a stack of only 2 identical layers get?
In the Moshi paper's audio quality evaluation, at what codec frame rate do the two SpeechTokenizer configurations run?
In the Transformer model variations table, what development perplexity (not BLEU) does the big model have?
On which development set are the metrics in the Transformer paper's model variation table measured?
questions.expected_answer: The English-to-German development set, newstest2013 (Table 3 caption).

questions.question: How many attention heads does the base Transformer use, and what development BLEU does the base configuration reach in the variation table?

quotes.quote: In this work we employ h=8 parallel attention layers, or heads.

questions.question: In Table 3 of the Transformer paper, what development BLEU does the variant with 64 attention heads achieve?
questions.expected_answer: Refuse: Table 3 varies h over 1, 4, 16 and 32 (and 8 in base, 16 in big); no variant has 64 heads.

questions.question: What test-set BLEU does the Transformer variant with 12 identical layers get in the model variation table?
questions.expected_answer: Refuse: no N = 12 row, and the table reports development-set metrics only.
